risks.risk: Keyboard may have dead/sticky keys or faulty buttons (seller claims all work, but no test shown).
risks.proof: Video of power-on and a full key sweep (press every key across the keyboard) plus pressing each button/knob; include audio output.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as not fully tested / possible key or button faults.

risks.risk: Sound quality issues (crackle/noise) or speaker/headphone output problems.
risks.proof: Short audio recording playing several notes and using at least 2–3 different sounds/tones; show speaker and (if possible) headphone output.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as having unknown sound quality (assume worst case: crackle/noise possible).

risks.risk: Missing adapter or wrong adapter (keyboard may not power without correct voltage/plug).
risks.proof: Photo of the exact adapter included (label showing voltage/amp and plug type) and a video showing the keyboard powering on with it.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as adapter not included / power not guaranteed.

risks.risk: Model/brand mismatch (identity not readable; pricing depends heavily on model).
risks.proof: Clear photo of the model/brand label (usually on the back/bottom) and the full control panel.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as a generic used electronic keyboard (worst-case value for unknown model).

risks.risk: Physical damage not visible due to plastic wrap (cracks, bent casing, broken stand/pedals).
risks.proof: Unwrapped close-up photos of corners, keybed edges, speaker area, and any ports/power socket; include a photo of the underside.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as possibly cosmetically worn and unverified condition.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the brand/model label (back or bottom) so the exact model can be priced.
Video: power-on + full key press test (every key) with audio.
Video/audio: demonstrate multiple tones/sounds and confirm no crackle; show speaker output.
Photo of the adapter included (label with voltage/amp) and video powering the keyboard using it.
response.reason: The photos show a wrapped electronic keyboard but do not provide a readable brand/model or any power-on/key test. Without proof of identity and working condition (and adapter inclusion), a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
